name: RINDAX RSS Job Finder
description: Scheduled daily search across 11 freelance/remote job sources (Upwork, LinkedIn, Contra, PeoplePerHour, Freelancer, Truelancer, Hubstaff Talent, Naukri, Reddit r/forhire, and general web search) for n8n, Power BI, Excel, and AI-automation roles. Scores and filters results, splits them into 'Direct Mail' (has a named contact email) vs 'ATS' (apply-on-portal) leads, logs new ones to Airtable, and sends a Telegram digest.

nodes.name: Search Jobs (x17 parallel queries)
nodes.notes: 17 parallel HTTP calls to a search API (site: filters for Upwork, LinkedIn, Contra, PeoplePerHour, Freelancer, Truelancer, Hubstaff Talent, Naukri, Reddit r/forhire, plus general n8n/Power BI/Excel/automation queries), merged via a chain of Merge nodes

nodes.name: Filter and Score Jobs
nodes.notes: Keyword + regex scoring engine: rejects senior/BDR/generic-corp titles, requires a work-type keyword (remote/freelance/contract), penalizes stale/high annual-salary postings, boosts n8n/Power BI/Excel/automation matches, boosts named-contact emails and preferred source domains. Keeps items scoring 65+.

nodes.name: Split Type A or B
nodes.notes: Routes to Direct Mail (named contact email found) or ATS (apply-on-portal) branch

nodes.name: Dedup Check + Log to Airtable (both branches)
nodes.notes: Searches the Direct Mail / ATS table by job title before creating a new record, to avoid duplicate alerts

nodes.name: Build Telegram Message
nodes.notes: Formats a daily digest: counts + top 5 Direct Mail leads (with score, pay, contact email, link) and top 5 ATS leads

main.node: Dedup Check + Log to Airtable (both branches)

companion_workflows: RINDAX Job Email Approver — listens for a Telegram approval command, drafts a personalized cold email via an AI model, sends it through Gmail, and updates the Airtable status.
RINDAX Job Draft Email Bridge — a newer version of the same approval step using native Telegram inline buttons (tap to send, buttons disappear after use) instead of a text command.
meta.security_note: API keys and bot tokens must be stored in n8n's credential manager, not pasted directly into HTTP Request node parameters — the header/body values above are illustrative placeholders only.
